objective: Optimize ordinary internal read throughput, small/random latency and game loading/streaming with integrity and compatibility preserved
current_authorization: Prepare/save independent plan only; no implementation/build/staging/device/console/native action; hardware gates locked until user supplies details
branch_boundary: Separate exact fixture admission/custody/manifests. Original RO1/BF prerequisites remain unchanged for original branch; no inherited BF files, keys, nonces or receipts
gate_transition_rule: Device details are necessary; resolve actual compatibility, identity/data disposition, exact reviewed bounded protocol and current human authorization before any released action. No automatic self-unlock or templates-as-proof.

stages.name: Device details and compatible baseline
stages.hardware: Future bounded identity/provisioning preflight after owner details; current planning only
stages.work: Bind exact CECH/current firmware/homebrew/recovery/SSD identity/data disposition; no assumed P13/model compatibility or protected-drive reuse

stages.name: Detached diagnostic adaptation and host/binary review
stages.work: New manifests/paths/public references/nonce/title/version and ABI/layout/space checks; retain caps, stop, errors and publication; no BF/old RO1 writer replay

stages.name: Native zero-payload pilot
stages.work: Actual loader/timer/CPU/UI/controller/exit/XMB acceptance; zero intentional HDD payload writes

stages.name: Owned I/O pilot and known-data fixture admission
stages.work: New owned <=256MiB pilot then three512MiB/16-file mix corpus; full initial/global/ordinary-restart verification and explicit cumulative setup ledger

stages.name: Internal read baseline
stages.work: CPU/FS decomposition, balanced reads, buffer/locality/random/file-mix/timing controls; retain latency/rc/bytes/cleanup and cache-state limits

stages.name: Attribution and one-factor read optimizations
stages.hardware: PC analysis/development; targeted native A/B required
stages.work: Prioritize ordinary read buffering/locality/read-ahead/copies; deeper shared FS/driver/crypto only with evidence and exact firmware/ABI/locking/error review

stages.name: Game/loading/streaming and compatibility validation
stages.work: Owner-selected titles/scenes; matched baseline/candidate loading/stalls; content, ordinary restart, save/install and relevant error checks

stages.name: Independent prepared states and release decision
stages.work: Repeat in >=2 independently prepared states; all provisioning/conditioning/verification counted; no general device/model/stability claim from one sample

fixture.provisioning_format_metadata_scope: Not part of payload count and not authorized now. Bind exact dedicated SSD, retained data, firmware compatibility and recovery procedure separately before any formatting.
fixture.data_manifest: Fresh exact paths/IDs/public seed/pattern version/full SHA/slice SHA/size/offset/owner and evidence bindings; independently checked references; no real saves or old source image required
fixture.pilot_and_setup_budget: One cumulative ledger across pilot/main/pre-post-restart jobs; charge requests before reads/writes incl short fragments/retries/EOF; actual returned/written tracked separately; <=64positive fragments, zero/overreport/errors stop; partial files retained

workloads.purpose: CPU pipeline/calibration and monotonic native ticks; no storage
6 balanced 256MiB A/B read-only vs verified pairs plus2 independent256MiB post-checks
3 repeats x3 logical file ranges x64MiB; bind extents if claiming allocation location
4x16MiB timing-off/on read controls; exact timers and coverage
3 passes over16 owned files, aggregate<=64MiB per pass

baseline_read.actual_transport_queue_depth_link_NAND_g: unknown, not inferred from app QD1, SSD advertisement,512B sector report or console age
baseline_read.time_limit: 1200s cooperative active work/job; READY and cleanup/publication separately disclosed; no blocked-syscall deadline
baseline_read.cancellation: Before opens and earliest1MiB/64ops/250ms service; controller stop and accepted process-exit route; preserve first and cleanup errors
baseline_read.space_semantics: 130GiB conservative DR1 guard, independent of BF. Rebind actual native FS API/units/geometry; do not hardcode old RAW_FREE or BA values. Setup additionally checks next-write headroom.
baseline_read.cache_policy: First-pass unknown, repeated warm/mixed; no initial cache dropping/reboot-to-claim-cold or settings change. Later matched ordinary-cycle controls require actual labels.
baseline_read.timers: Actual native ticks/frequency, pre/post10000empty/event calibrations, independent elapsed, exclusive scopes, explicitly inclusive subscopes and bounded percentile intervals
baseline_read.interpretation: OS housekeeping may write; syscall-only transient bytes not certified by later verification; hidden driver/crypto/media inside FS call, residual is not a media timer

candidate_comparison.state_control: Same firmware baseline lineage, files/extents/occupancy,compiler/UI/timers/order; record cache,elapsed/idle/thermal/history confounding; one factor at a time

success_criteria.coverage_and_quantile_bins: Disclose inconclusive coverage or tail resolution; no confidence claims from correlated rolling/call samples
success_criteria.benefit_scope: Diagnostic-only improvements labeled separately; shared storage/game claim needs relevant game data/loading/streaming result and CPU/memory costs

priority_candidates: shared FS/driver/crypto only after exact firmware/lock/lifetime/coherence/retirement/flush/error review

later_scopes_locked.rule: Unknown scopes stay locked. Every conditioning/install/format/verify/cleanup cost declared before release; no silent TB fill, raw pass-through or removal of integrity/flush/reserve guards
